integrity: Proof by globally monotone power-series coefficient ratios and exact local Taylor analysis; finite tests do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Classification includes only primitive centrally symmetric two-cycles, not all period-two orbits or nonlinear elliptic stability. Analytical exactness does not imply exhaustive priority or independent validation.
title: A shape-driven saddle-center fold of antipodal two-cycles in a hyperbolic double-well map
